season.evidence: Searched: Mountaineers Lynch Glacier route notes describe walking over frozen Pea Soup Lake early season, with full-width crevasses, a wide moat and loose rock access later; Mountain Project says the moat is the later-season crux. Stored Jun-Jul stands (SummitPost peak page says Jun-Sep generally).

otherTracksConsidered.why: Undated peak-page file (inSeason false). Starts at the Peggy's Pond / Cathedral Pass side (47.556,-121.143) and reaches the summit along the south side by the southeast ridge; it never goes to Pea Soup Lake or the north-side Lynch Glacier (our route's approach is from Deception Pass), so the line is the southeast-ridge walk-up, a different route.

notes: The one track is the Peggy's Pond / southeast ridge line, not the Lynch Glacier.
